/-!
Halting equivalence before and after any internal fixed prefix of the actual
contextual-fold246 arithmetic evaluator. The exact checked bootstrap specializes that
result to its literal numeric target. No unbounded register or scheduler
simulation is supplied by these prefix-composition theorems.
Adapted from ArithmeticMachinePrefixPerm252, using the checked246 startup.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticMachinePrefixPrefix246
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticMachineRunFromPrefix246
open ArithmeticMachineRunPrefix246 (run)
open ArithmeticBootstrapPrefix246 (bootCode internal_boot)
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- Reordering two blocks of iterations of the same deterministic step. -/
lemma runFrom_commute (t u initial : V) :
    runFrom t (runFrom u initial) = runFrom u (runFrom t initial) := by
  calc
    runFrom t (runFrom u initial) = runFrom (u+t) initial :=
      (runFrom_add u t initial).symm
    _ = runFrom (t+u) initial := by rw [add_comm u t]
    _ = runFrom u (runFrom t initial) := runFrom_add t u initial

/-- A halt inside the prefix is handled by whole-configuration absorption.
No subtraction of clock bounds or assumed continuing prefix is needed. -/
theorem halts_after_prefix_iff (prefixTime initial : V) :
    (∃ time : V, first (runFrom time (runFrom prefixTime initial)) = 0) ↔
      (∃ time : V, first (runFrom time initial) = 0) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨time, ht⟩
    exact ⟨prefixTime+time, by rw [runFrom_add]; exact ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨time, ht⟩
    refine ⟨time, ?_⟩
    rw [runFrom_commute time prefixTime initial, runFrom_halted prefixTime _ ht]
    exact ht

/-- The prefix time is an arbitrary internal model value. -/
theorem blank_after_prefix_iff (prefixTime : V) :
    (∃ time : V, first (runFrom time (run prefixTime)) = 0) ↔
      (∃ time : V, first (run time) = 0) := by
  simpa only [runFrom_blank] using halts_after_prefix_iff prefixTime (1 : V)

/-- The fixed numeral bootstrap may now be removed without a runtime premise. -/
theorem boot_halts_iff :
    (∃ time : V, first (runFrom time (bootCode : V)) = 0) ↔
      (∃ time : V, first (run time) = 0) := by
  simpa only [internal_boot] using blank_after_prefix_iff (410735 : V)

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticMachinePrefixPrefix246

# Direct 246-state arbitrary-start and prefix arithmetic

These are uncompiled source drafts. No guard, preparation, compiler, version query, dependency build or maintained-file edit was performed. The only executed Python operations generated scratch source/guard text, parsed syntax, traversed source imports and hashed existing files.

No mathematical blocker was found. The 252-state proofs port by selecting the new 246 lookup and step definitions and changing the concrete bootstrap numeral to 410735. The old broad namespace opens were replaced with restricted opens: `lookupValue`, `lookupNat` and `genericStepValue` remain generic helpers in their existing Perm252 namespaces; the literal rows, action lookup, step, native step and blank run are explicitly the checked 246 definitions. Both increased proof options were removed. Existing prerequisite objects retain their historical proof settings; the new source and audit have default proof limits.

`run-from/ArithmeticMachineRunFromPrefix246.lean` has 173 lines. Its fixed `PR.Blueprint 1` graph is Σ₁/Δ₁ and total for every initial code and time in an IΣ₁ model. Internal Σ₁ induction proves run addition, whole-configuration halt absorption, and agreement with the checked blank evaluator at initial code 1. A separate ordinary-natural induction identifies standard code iteration. Lookup absence and numeral lookup are proved under IOpen. This unit adds no internal register or scheduler simulation. Its audit has 19 named probes and 23 typed callers, including arbitrary-environment Σ₁/Δ₁ graph interfaces.

`prefix/ArithmeticMachinePrefixPrefix246.lean` has 53 lines. The doubled word preserves the naming pattern `ArithmeticMachinePrefix` plus the candidate suffix `Prefix246`. Its four theorems commute iteration blocks and prove halting equivalence across any internal prefix, including prefixes that already contain a halt. The proof uses whole-code absorption rather than subtraction of times. The concrete specialization uses the checked `ArithmeticBootstrapPrefix246.internal_boot` at 410735. Its audit has four probes and six callers. It does not identify the resulting run with the seeded scheduler or ZFC proof codes.

`inventory.json` records all source/audit/guard hashes, exact parent evidence, project closures and supplied cache boundaries. RunFrom has 27 prerequisite project modules and three direct external boundaries; Prefix has 43 and four, with only the new RunFrom object pending. All known selected source/object pairs were rehashed. Both guards have the same AST body as the already reviewed strict arithmetic246 template; only the literal configuration differs. The template uses one thread, 4096 MiB and a shared 120-second source/audit budget, with no dependency builds or compiler-version queries.

The RunFrom guard pins the maintained exact Run246 PASS record `e531e7cd2313988da8c01809a4a5a4802acdfbb0debb93bfe2cb7b9d8b0f71a4`. The Prefix guard pins the maintained Bootstrap246 PASS record `ea64f87a9cb6a88f53503d31c24fe45c051f7173d13f957ca565befe6309240e` and refuses even preparation while its RunFrom parent hash is pending. import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticMachineRunFromPrefix246
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticBootstrapPrefix246

/-!
Halting equivalence before and after any internal fixed prefix of the actual
contextual-fold246 arithmetic evaluator. The exact checked bootstrap specializes that
result to its literal numeric target. No unbounded register or scheduler
simulation is supplied by these prefix-composition theorems.
Adapted from ArithmeticMachinePrefixPerm252, using the checked246 startup.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticMachinePrefixPrefix246
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticMachineRunFromPrefix246
open ArithmeticMachineRunPrefix246 (run)
open ArithmeticBootstrapPrefix246 (bootCode internal_boot)
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- Reordering two blocks of iterations of the same deterministic step. -/
lemma runFrom_commute (t u initial : V) :
    runFrom t (runFrom u initial) = runFrom u (runFrom t initial) := by
  calc
    runFrom t (runFrom u initial) = runFrom (u+t) initial :=
      (runFrom_add u t initial).symm
    _ = runFrom (t+u) initial := by rw [add_comm u t]
    _ = runFrom u (runFrom t initial) := runFrom_add t u initial

/-- A halt inside the prefix is handled by whole-configuration absorption.
No subtraction of clock bounds or assumed continuing prefix is needed. -/
theorem halts_after_prefix_iff (prefixTime initial : V) :
    (∃ time : V, first (runFrom time (runFrom prefixTime initial)) = 0) ↔
      (∃ time : V, first (runFrom time initial) = 0) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨time, ht⟩

theorem blank_after_prefix_iff (prefixTime : V) :

  simpa only [runFrom_blank] using halts_after_prefix_iff prefixTime (1 : V)

  simpa only [internal_boot] using blank_after_prefix_iff (410735 : V)
